name: Document format
purpose: holds a text meant to be read as pages, with its layout
note: The group where the deepest split in this whole list sits: a PDF keeps the PAGE and an ODF keeps the TEXT, which is why one is for sending and the other for writing

name: Image format
purpose: holds a picture, as a photograph or as a drawing
note: The split people actually meet is inside this group: a photo is a JPEG and a logo is a PNG, and almost nobody has been told why

name: Audio format
purpose: holds sound — music, speech, a recording

name: Video format
purpose: holds moving pictures together with their sound
note: Its German article is about CONTAINER formats, and that is the right word: a video file is a box holding a picture stream and a sound stream, not one thing

name: Compression format
purpose: makes one or more files smaller, and can give them back exactly as they were
note: „Zippen" became the verb for the whole idea, the way „googeln" did for searching — one product's name standing in for what a dozen of them do

name: Markup language
purpose: holds text together with marks saying what each part IS — a heading, a link, a table
note: The one group whose files a person reads all day and never opens: every web page is one, delivered rather than stored

name: Table format
purpose: holds rows and columns — the shape a spreadsheet works in
